question: A food pantry started Monday with 209 cans of soup. A shipment added 42 more cans. Unrelated to soup, a nearby bakery donated 150 loaves of bread that same day. On Tuesday, 18 cans were given to a family in need. On Wednesday, 136 more cans were distributed at a community event. On Thursday, 84 more cans were sent to a shelter. How many cans of soup were left at the pantry?

A tool hire shop had 33 ladders on its rack. A firm that was closing sold it 58 ladders, and an auction added 79 more. A building contract then took 147 ladders away for the season. The shop ordered 7 ladders for every ladder left on the rack. Half of the yard is under cover, and hire is charged in hours although the paperwork is filled in by the minute. How many ladders does the order come to?
Two workers compared output. One completed 40 units initially. They multiplied by 8, added 19, multiplied by 7, lost 2106, and added 76 recovery units. How many units?
A schedule starts with 99 events. In the morning, 67 are canceled (32). By midday, 50 are rescheduled (82). By afternoon, 25 are moved (57). By evening, 12 are added (69). How many events remain?
A factory started with 128 units. They removed 15 units. They increased 6 times. They removed 542 units. Finally, they increased 6 times. How many units do they have?

Hassan filled 201 sandbags on the first day and exactly the same number on the second, so 2 days of his work went into the pile. His neighbour Lucia added 79 sandbags and a council lorry brought 78 more, so Lucia's contribution was far smaller than Hassan's. Each sandbag in the pile holds 3 buckets of sand. Every bucket of sand weighs 4 kilograms. The flood defence used up 1647 kilograms of that sand. How many kilograms of sand are left?

Yasmin bottled 206 litres of apple juice on each of 3 days. A supermarket order then took 297 litres from the store. Her partner Callum, who bottled far less than Yasmin, took another 213 litres for his own shop. A school fete bought 97 litres after that. The pair have pressed apples together for a dozen years. How many litres are left in the store?

The soup kitchen made 174 pints of stew and serves it in cups, at 2 cups to a pint. It served 147 cups at lunch, then a volunteer brought 40 cups more. At dinner 221 cups were served, and 66 cups were sent from another kitchen. How many cups of stew are left?

Three colleagues tracked a complex project. Beginning stage: 175 tasks. She multiplied by 3 for planning. She divided by 3 (cancelling to 175). She multiplied by 4 for execution. She subtracted 516 completed. She added 77 new tasks. She added 17 contingency. How many tasks remain?

A retail store started with 49 items. Morning brought 19 more. This was multiplied by 5. She added 21. She added 80. This was multiplied by 4. She removed 1659 for a big sale. Measured in dollars (price conversion), what remained?
Two managers compared. One had 56 tasks. Multiplied by 3. Removed 11. Multiplied by 8. Lost 1121 cancel. Lost 129 more. How many?

Ravi tracked the total dollars in his savings account all month, starting at 110 dollars. His roommate, Tomás, had a separate account with 900 dollars, far more than Ravi's, but only Ravi's account is tracked here. A paycheck deposit added 49 dollars to Ravi's account. Rent then took out 38 dollars. Groceries took another 70 dollars. A phone bill took 39 more dollars. Finally, a bonus at work tripled whatever remained in Ravi's tracked account. How much money was in Ravi's account by the end of the month?

In the morning, a bakery had 173 loaves of bread ready. By midday, seven more matching batches made the total eight times as large. In the afternoon, 43 more loaves came out of a late batch. Later, 52 more loaves were baked. Still later, 38 more loaves came out. By evening, 4 more loaves were added from a small batch. Finally, 40 more loaves came out of the last oven run. How many loaves of bread did the bakery have by the end of the day?

A school had 18 trophies in its display case, even though the school has 20 sports teams. A move to a new case lost 15 trophies in the shuffle. Four more matching cases were combined, making the total five times as large. Two more matching cases were combined, making it three times as large. Finally, 26 more trophies were added from storage. How many trophies were in the display case at the end?

A server held 215 gigabytes initially. In the morning, 104 were used, reducing capacity. They multiplied by 4 through expansion. Then multiplied by 2 again for backup systems. Later, 856 gigabytes were removed from allocation. Finally, 6 more gigabytes were added as buffer. A cloud service allocated 1000 gigabytes but different system. How many gigabytes available total?

A business inventory began at 186 units. They added 42 units from morning deliveries. They added 30 more units by afternoon. They subtracted 169 units from sales. This remaining count was multiplied by 5 for quarterly forecasting (measured in quarterly units). John and Mary compared inventory across two locations. The second location had 75 units (separate total). What was the quarterly forecast?

A warehouse started with 112 boxes. They increased stock 3 times to 336 boxes. They added 57 more boxes, reaching 393. They removed 121 boxes for shipment, leaving 272. They added 74 boxes from a delivery. They multiplied their final count 7 times for a year-end projection. How many boxes are projected for year-end inventory?

A software company starts the year with 124 thousand active subscribers. A viral campaign triples the subscriber count. A partnership deal then multiplies subscribers by 9. Afterward, 2246 thousand subscribers churn out during a price hike. A win-back campaign adds 37 thousand subscribers. Finally, a global launch multiplies the remaining subscribers by 5. How many thousand subscribers does the company have now?

A candle shop had 154 candles in stock, valued at 15,400 cents, even though the shop sells 30 different scents. Eight matching wholesale shipments arrived, making the stock nine times as large. Five more matching shipments then made it six times as large again. A big holiday order shipped out 2,905 candles. Finally, 19 more candles were added from a returned order. How many candles were left in the shop?

A cake stall started the day with 59 sponge cakes, and 16 of them were bought whole by a caterer. Every cake still on the stall was cut into 3 slices. 35 slices went across to a coffee morning, 63 were sold at the counter, and 26 were taken to the staff room. A late bake then added 63 slices to the tray. The hall clock runs 15 minutes slow. The price card is written in cents rather than in dollars. How many slices are on the tray?

A business had 214 items in inventory. They added 31 more through purchasing. Then 19 additional items came in. After sales, they removed 222 items. They added 36 more from restocking. Finally, 54 additional items were received. A competing store had 1000 items but separate. How many total items in current inventory?

A community hall began its refit with 97 boxes of floor tiles, and a supplier delivered 63 more boxes. Every box in the hall contained 4 tiles. The hall itself is 45 metres long. When the boxes were opened, 374 tiles were found to be cracked and were thrown out. Each surviving tile had to be fixed down with 6 metal clips, and every clip on the invoice was priced at 8 cents. The builder writes the bill in cents rather than in dollars. How many cents did the clips cost in total?

A storage facility had 100 items. They divided by 4 for location distribution. They subtracted 2 items for cleanup. They added 8 items from new stock. They added 15 more items. Finally, 7 items were removed. Using minutes and hours as measurement, how many items are distributed?

A business started with 169 items. Production increased 9 times. They removed 620 items. They added 26 items. They tripled their inventory. A nearby business had 500 items. How many items do they have?

A single charity's coin collection started the month with 150 dollars. The total was split evenly among 6 collection boxes, and this story follows just one box. That box then lost 14 dollars to a counting error. A matching sponsor multiplied that box's total by 9, after a fundraiser that lasted about 180 minutes, exactly 3 hours. A bank fee then cost the box 13 dollars. Finally, a year-end match multiplied the box's total by 4. A second nearby box held about a dozen dollars in loose coins, unrelated to this one. How much money was in that one box in the end?
